LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.4 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Fluency and pac
Topic 2.5: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of Reading 2.4 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Fluency and pac in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How does reading foster a positive attitude toward language learning?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: the learner engages in critical and constructive dialogue with peers to explore the value of engaging in positive

leisure time activities.

• Learning to Learn: the learner is motivated to learn continuously when they organise a reader’s theatre to improve their

reading proficiency.

Values:
Peace: the learner displays tolerance to the diverse viewpoints and perspectives of their peers on leisure time activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer pressure awareness is promoted as the learner explores positive ways of using their leisure time.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner relates their learning to Social Studies on the concept of management of one’s leisure time.
